findings.title: dry-check rejects the manifest format consumed by the launcher
findings.evidence: ops-d73-exact-nodes/dry-check.sh:75 invokes python -m json.tool on D73_MANIFEST, while tools/p4-d73-pinned-launch.sh:16-22 consumes newline-delimited key=value entries and the reviewed control fixture writes that same format at tests/sdk/test_p4_d73_pinned_launcher.py:128.
findings.observed: Running --source-check with an existing key=value launcher manifest failed with 'manifest JSON parse failed'.
findings.impact: Once the real manifest is rendered, the advertised source-check and therefore --controls path cannot admit it.
findings.required_fix: Validate the actual key=value manifest format (or use a separate JSON source receipt without passing it as the launcher manifest).

findings.title: the advertised controls path does not exercise the production run CLI
findings.evidence: ops-d73-exact-nodes/dry-check.sh:82-87 runs pytest on the focused test file; that test invokes the launcher as [manifest, 'dry', '--', command] at tests/sdk/test_p4_d73_pinned_launcher.py:155. The candidate README claims --controls calls the reviewed launcher through real run -- argv, but no run-mode invocation is present in the candidate or focused test.
findings.impact: The bounded PASS covers the dry stub path only; it does not validate the exact production run -- entrypoint used by the two suite rows.
findings.required_fix: Either change the candidate claim to the supported dry control, or add/review a bounded control that actually invokes the launcher with run -- and preserves the positive-17/poison-zero assertions.
